sloka: तव दैवासुरे युद्धे सहराजर्षिभिः पतिः ।अगच्छत्त्वामुपादाय देवराजस्य साह्यकृत् ॥२-९-११॥
transliteration: tava daivāsure yuddhe saharājarṣibhiḥ patiḥ ।agacchattvāmupādāya devarājasya sāhyakṛt ॥2-9-11॥

translations.english: O queen during the war between gods and asuras, your husband went with royal saints intending to render assistance to Indra, king of the gods, taking you along with him. He set off in the southern direction of Dandaka forest to a renowned city called Vaijayanta where asura Timidhvaja lived.
translations.hindi: ॐ पाठान्तरे--यदा । जाती है । बिना सूये के लोक भले ही बने रहे, बिना जल बरसे: है. अपराध कमुदिश्य' त्यक्ष्यामीष्टमह सुतम्‌ । कोसल्यां वा सुमित्रां वा त्यजेयमपि वा श्रियम्‌
